universe: A-share main-board stocks tracked by this repository

method.trend: cross-sectional MA20 participation plus median 20d stock return
method.breadth: daily advancers / stocks with usable daily change
method.liquidity: sum(close*volume) across tracked stocks versus prior-20-session median
method.risk: deterministic combination of trend, breadth and liquidity; context only, not a hard buy/sell gate
